post.description: Issue a nonce a native app must send to the provider and back to us.

Sign in with an id_token obtained by a native SDK.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 when the nonce is unknown or expired.

delete.description: Delete the account; the user row is kept soft-deleted so history stays attributable.

post.description: Create a household with the caller as its first member.

delete.description: Delete a household and all of its data.
Remove a member; removing the last member deletes the household.

post.description: Join the household behind an invite code.

Add a quantity, creating the item if it does not exist.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 when the unit's dimension conflicts with the stored item.

patch.description:
Set the absolute quantity, unit, expiry, or notes of an item.

Send ``null`` for ``expires_at`` or ``notes`` to clear them.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 422 when the unit changes dimension without a quantity.

delete.description: Delete an item and its history.

post.description: Revert every change made by the latest agent run in a thread.

get.description: Threads of the household, most recently active first.
A thread with its full message history for the UI, including prompts of failed runs.

delete.description: Delete a thread and its runs; inventory events keep their thread id but lose the run link.

post.description:
Send a message and stream the reply as a Vercel AI SDK data stream.

Only the newest user message from the request body is used; the conversation history
comes from the server.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 when the thread already has a run in progress.

get.description: List or search recipes by title or ingredient.

post.description: Consume the recipe's ingredients from the inventory; an empty body means the recipe's servings.
Start the shop login; the user finishes it by pasting the callback URL.

Exchange the pasted callback for tokens and store them for the household.

The state is consumed before the code is spent, so a second paste cannot exchange it again.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 when the state is unknown, expired, or belongs to another household;
        401 when the shop rejects the code; 502 when the shop cannot be reached.
